sbx run <<'EOF'

sbx run <<'EOF'

export TESSDATA_PREFIX=/workspace/.tools/usr/share/tesseract-ocr/5/tessdata

sbx run <<'EOF'

sbx run <<'EOF'
set -e
mkdir -p /var/lib/dpkg/{info,updates,triggers} /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/log

for d in /workspace/.debs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$d" /workspace/.tools; done
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/.tools/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/workspace/.tools/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
export PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.tools/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages
python3 -c "from PIL import Image; im=Image.open('/app/documents/F0oZMhSUm2dO.jpg'); print(im.size, im.mode, im.getextrema())"

sbx run <<'EOF'
export PATH=/workspace/.tools/usr/bin:$PATH
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/.tools/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/workspace/.tools/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
export TESSDATA_PREFIX=/workspace/.tools/usr/share/tesseract-ocr/5/tessdata
export PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.tools/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages
python3 <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageOps, ImageFilter
im=Image.open('/app/documents/F0oZMhSUm2dO.jpg').convert('L')
for ang in (0,90,180,270):
    r=im.rotate(ang, expand=True)
    r=ImageOps.autocontrast(r)
    r=r.resize((r.width*2, r.height*2), Image.LANCZOS)
    r.save(f'/tmp/f0_{ang}.png')
# also enhance
r=ImageOps.autocontrast(im)
r=r.point(lambda p: 0 if p<140 else 255)
r=r.resize((r.width*2, r.height*2), Image.LANCZOS)
r.save('/tmp/f0_bin.png')
PY
for f in /tmp/f0_*.png; do echo "===== $f ====="; tesseract "$f" - --psm 3 -l eng 2>/dev/null | sed '/^$/d' | head -60; done
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
export PATH=/workspace/.tools/usr/bin:$PATH
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/.tools/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/workspace/.tools/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
export TESSDATA_PREFIX=/workspace/.tools/usr/share/tesseract-ocr/5/tessdata
export PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.tools/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages
python3 <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageOps
import numpy as np
im=Image.open('/app/documents/F0oZMhSUm2dO.jpg').convert('L')
a=np.array(im)
print("mean",a.mean(),"dark%",(a<128).mean(),"verydark%",(a<50).mean())
# row/col ink profile to locate content
for name,arr in [('rows',(a<128).sum(1)),('cols',(a<128).sum(0))]:
    idx=np.where(arr>arr.max()*0.05)[0]
    print(name, idx.min(), idx.max(), "max",arr.max())
inv=ImageOps.invert(im)
inv=ImageOps.autocontrast(inv).resize((im.width*2,im.height*2),Image.LANCZOS)
inv.save('/tmp/f0_inv.png')
PY
for p in 1 3 6 11; do echo "=== inv psm $p ==="; tesseract /tmp/f0_inv.png - --psm $p -l eng 2>/dev/null | sed '/^$/d' | head -40; done
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
export PATH=/workspace/.tools/usr/bin:$PATH
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/.tools/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/workspace/.tools/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
export TESSDATA_PREFIX=/workspace/.tools/usr/share/tesseract-ocr/5/tessdata
export PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.tools/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages
python3 <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageOps
im=Image.open('/app/documents/F0oZMhSUm2dO.jpg').convert('L')
h=im.histogram(); n=sum(h)
print("mean", sum(i*c for i,c in enumerate(h))/n, "dark%", sum(h[:128])/n, "verydark%", sum(h[:50])/n)
for name,fn in [('inv',lambda x: ImageOps.invert(x)),('invbin',lambda x: ImageOps.invert(x).point(lambda p:0 if p<100 else 255))]:
    o=fn(im).resize((im.width*2,im.height*2),Image.LANCZOS)
    o.save(f'/tmp/f0_{name}.png')
PY
for f in /tmp/f0_inv*.png; do for p in 3 6 11; do echo "=== $f psm $p ==="; tesseract "$f" - --psm $p -l eng 2>/dev/null | sed '/^$/d' | head -30; done; done
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
set -e
mkdir -p /app/invoices /app/other
python3 <<'PY'
import csv, os, shutil
from decimal import Decimal

# invoices: (filename, total_incl_tax, vat)
invoices = {
    "2lgKzDuI4E4g.jpg": ("6558.00", "0.00"),
    "JOiylq2_7S18.jpg": ("6860.45", "623.68"),
    "KrJiw0OZx7jf.jpg": ("9963.00", "0.00"),
    "T0r6Ou8zvqTA.pdf": ("4031.00", "0.00"),
    "UsN9tVTKskms.pdf": ("896.00", "0.00"),
    "ivE2mt3HwvEO.jpg": ("819.06", "74.46"),
    "lxtL9XrYRsVG.jpg": ("797.91", "72.54"),
    "vvK89XK847m3.jpg": ("6204.19", "564.02"),
    "w0i40MJP2Dzm.jpg": ("44745.59", "4067.78"),
    "wIQEB5nR79b2.pdf": ("440.00", "0.00"),
}
others = {
    "6NVuAIhTV4KB.jpg",
    "F0oZMhSUm2dO.jpg",
    "GFAlpKoFg81H.pdf",
    "QOoA_j33PD_E.jpg",
    "WqWMArQQlSMv.jpg",
    "dvkRkFVFhHga.pdf",
    "dx0AWchV01ZJ.pdf",
}

src = "/app/documents"
present = set(os.listdir(src))
assert present == set(invoices) | others, (present - set(invoices) - others, set(invoices) | others - present)

for f in sorted(invoices):
    shutil.move(os.path.join(src, f), os.path.join("/app/invoices", f))
for f in sorted(others):
    shutil.move(os.path.join(src, f), os.path.join("/app/other", f))

rows = []
tot = Decimal("0.00")
vattot = Decimal("0.00")
for f in sorted(invoices):
    total, vat = invoices[f]
    rows.append([f, f"{Decimal(total):.2f}", f"{Decimal(vat):.2f}"])
    tot += Decimal(total)
    vattot += Decimal(vat)
rows.append(["total", f"{tot:.2f}", f"{vattot:.2f}"])

with open("/app/invoices/summary.csv", "w", newline="") as fh:
    w = csv.writer(fh)
    w.writerow(["filename", "total_amount", "vat_amount"])
    w.writerows(rows)

print("documents remaining:", os.listdir(src))
print("invoices:", sorted(os.listdir("/app/invoices")))
print("other:", sorted(os.listdir("/app/other")))
print("totals:", tot, vattot)
PY
echo "=== summary.csv ==="
cat /app/invoices/summary.csv
echo "=== counts ==="
find /app/documents -mindepth 1 | wc -l
ls /app/invoices | wc -l
ls /app/other | wc -l
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
rm -rf /workspace/.tools /workspace/.debs /workspace/.txt
